arxiv-2102-00847.title: CoordiQ : Coordinated Q-learning for Electric Vehicle Charging Recommendation
arxiv-2102-00847.creator: Carter W. Blum, Liu Hao, Hui Xiong
arxiv-2102-00847.description:
A 2021 arXiv research paper by Carter W. Blum, Liu Hao, Hui Xiong. 1
Abstract

Electric vehicles have been rapidly increasing in usage, but stations to charge them have not always kept up with demand, so efficient routing of vehicles to stations is critical to operating at maximum efficiency. Deciding which stations to recommend drivers to is a complex problem with a multitude of possible recommendations, volatile usage patterns and temporally extended consequences of recommendations.

arxiv-2202-12304.description: Abstract We exploit the unprecedented depth of integral field data from the KMOS Ultra-deep Rotational Velocity Survey (KURVS) to analyse the strong (H α \alpha ) and forbidden ([N ii ], [S ii] ) emission line ratios in 22 main-sequence galaxies at z ≈ 1.5 z\,\approx\,1.5 .

arxiv-2306-02483.title: Performance of near-optimal protocol in weakly driven processes
arxiv-2306-02483.creator: Pierre Nazé
arxiv-2306-02483.description: Abstract A natural criticism of the optimal protocol of the irreversible work found for weakly driven processes is its experimental difficulty in being implementable due to its singular part. In this work, I explore the possibility of taking its continuous linear part as an acceptable near-optimal protocol.

arxiv-2311-01705.title: Off-axis Afterglow Closure Relations and Fermi-LAT Detected Gamma-Ray Bursts Journal: ApJ
arxiv-2311-01705.creator: N. Fraija, M. G. Dainotti, D. Levine, B. Betancourt Kamenetskaia, A. Galvan-Gamez
arxiv-2311-01705.description: Abstract Gamma-ray bursts (GRBs) are one of the most promising transient events for studying multi-wavelength observations in extreme conditions. Observation of GeV photons from bursts would provide crucial information on GRB physics, including the off-axis emission. The Second Gamma-ray Burst Catalog (2FLGC) was announced by the Fermi Large Area Telescope (Fermi-LAT) Collaboration.

arxiv-2405-19928.title: BAN: Detecting Backdoors Activated by Adversarial Neuron Noise
arxiv-2405-19928.creator: Xiaoyun Xu, Zhuoran Liu *, Stefanos Koffas, Shujian Yu, Stjepan Picek
arxiv-2405-19928.description: Abstract Backdoor attacks on deep learning represent a recent threat that has gained significant attention in the research community. Backdoor defenses are mainly based on backdoor inversion, which has been shown to be generic, model-agnostic, and applicable to practical threat scenarios.

arxiv-2407-12163.title: Bellman Diffusion Models
arxiv-2407-12163.creator: Liam Schramm, Abdeslam Boularias
arxiv-2407-12163.description: Abstract Diffusion models have seen tremendous success as generative architectures. Recently, they have been shown to be effective at modelling policies for offline reinforcement learning and imitation learning. We explore using diffusion as a model class for the successor state measure (SSM) of a policy.

arxiv-2503-22477.title: Chemical enhancement of superconductivity in LaRu 3 Si 2 with mode-selective coupling between kagome phonons and flat bands
arxiv-2503-22477.creator: Ryo Misawa 1, Markus Kriener 2, Rinsuke Yamada 1, Ryota Nakano 1, Milena Jovanovic 2,3, Leslie M. Schoop 2, Max Hirschberger 1,4
arxiv-2503-22477.description: Abstract In kagome metals, flat electronic bands induced by frustrated hopping are a platform for strong electron correlations. In particular, a selective coupling of flat band states to certain kagome phonon modes is proposed as a universal origin of superconductivity in this material class.

arxiv-2602-08512.title: Constraints on Higgs Light Yukawa Couplings with the CMS Detector
arxiv-2602-08512.creator: Alberto Zucchetta 1 , on behalf of the CMS Collaboration
arxiv-2602-08512.description: Abstract The discovery of the Higgs boson ten years ago and successful measurement of the Higgs boson couplings to third generation fermions by LHC mark great milestones for HEP. The much weaker coupling to the second generation quarks predicted by the SM makes the measurement of the light Yukawa Higgs couplings, as the Higgs-charm ones, much more challenging.

pmc-10656566.title: Analysis of the relationship between urban dynamics and prevalence of remote work based on population data generated from cellular networks
pmc-10656566.creator: Hiroto Akatsuka, Masashi Toyoda
pmc-10656566.description: The COVID-19 pandemic has accelerated the introduction of remote work as one way to ensure employee safety and reduce the amount of interpersonal contact while continuing business operations. Knowing the degree of prevalence of remote work and its establishment are considered to be important factors in future policies and urban planning.

pmc-10726881.title: Staging Parkinson's disease according to the MNCD classification correlates with caregiver burden
pmc-10726881.creator: Diego Santos‐García, Teresa de Deus Fonticoba, Carlos Cores Bartolomé, María J Feal Painceiras, Iago García Díaz, María Cristina Íñiguez Alvarado, Jose Manuel Paz, Silvia Jesús, Marina Cosgaya, Juan García Caldentey, Nuria Caballol, Ines Legarda, Jorge Hernández Vara, Iria Cabo, Lydia López Manzanar
pmc-10726881.description: Background and objectiveRecently, we demonstrated that staging Parkinson's disease (PD) with a novel simple classification called MNCD, based on four axes (motor, non‐motor, cognition, and dependency) and five stages, correlated with disease severity and patients’ quality of life. Here, we analyzed the correlation of MNCD staging with PD caregiver's status.

pmc-11537408.title: Registered report: The effectiveness of a Bhagavad Gita intervention to reduce psychological distress in homeless people—A randomised controlled trial
pmc-11537408.creator: Laalithya Konduru, Simranjeet Singh Dahia, Gargi Kothari-Speakman, Vanessa Carels, Vanessa Carels, Avanti Dey, Avanti Dey, Avanti Dey
pmc-11537408.description: IntroductionThe coronavirus disease pandemic has worsened psychological distress in people experiencing homelessness (PEH). This study evaluates the impact of learning the Bhagavad Gita versus engaging in Kuchipudi dance on reducing psychological distress in PEH in Chennai and Dhanbad, India.Methods and analysisParticipants will be allocated into Bhagavad Gita, Kuchipudi dance, Both interventions, or Control groups.

pmc-12693754.title: EEG Sensor-Based Parkinson’s Disease Detection Using a Multi-Domain Feature Fusion Network
pmc-12693754.creator: Jinxuan Wang, Hua Huo, Shilu Kang, Lan Ma, Chen Zhang
pmc-12693754.description: Parkinson’s disease (PD) is a common neurodegenerative disorder, and accurate identification of PD is critical for clinical diagnosis and disease management. Electroencephalography (EEG) sensors provide reliable real-time brain signal acquisition, making them practical biosensing modalities for PD detection. However, due to their non-stationarity, single time-domain or frequency-domain analysis methods are insufficient to extract robust discriminative features from EEG signals.

pmc-13119565.title: Polarization of Hepatic Macrophages in Alveolar Echinococcosis and Its Role in Remodeling the Immune Microenvironment
pmc-13119565.creator: Hai Xu, Yanxiong Wang, Lin Mi, Li Ren, Zhixin Wang

pmc-13679247.title: Lower fibrinogen and fibrinogen-to-albumin ratio in migraine with white matter hyperintensities: implications for microvascular vulnerability
pmc-13679247.creator: Aslıhan Baran
pmc-13679247.description: BackgroundWhite matter hyperintensities (WMH) are increasingly recognized as imaging markers of migraine-related cerebral small-vessel injury. However, the biological correlates underlying WMH in migraine remain poorly defined. The relationship between WMH and the fibrinogen-to-albumin ratio (FAR), a composite hemostatic marker, has not yet been evaluated.
